verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook is a SaaS research product and a Workspace core service, so a separate sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents only source upload, grounded chat, generated artifacts, sharing and exports. Nothing describes a sandbox, test environment, dry-run mode, or any separation from production data, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
